meaning:
1) of nought, good for nothing, worthless
1a) of physicians, a shepherd, a divination
1b) of false gods

renderings.kjv: and I will cause their images

elsewhere.note: “ ‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.
For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.
